mentions.name: LED Globe World Viewing Portal
mentions.description: This hardware project is an LED globe serving as a world viewing portal, powered by a Raspberry Pi that plays pre-generated AI videos of places around the world. It is being upgraded to generate the videos in realtime and to make the hardware more durable and portable so it can be hauled around for community use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built an LED globe with a world viewing portal that uses a raspberry pi and pre-generated AI videos of places around the world. I'm working on upgrading it to do realtime generation of the videos and to improve the hardware so it is more durable and capable of being hauled around for community use.
